fato_historico: 2018: The 7.5 Mw 2018 Sulawesi earthquake, which triggered a large tsunami, leaves 4,340 dead and 10,679 injured.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a deep tide rising within your soul. Just as the earth shifts and moves, remember that your emotional resilience is your greatest anchor. It is a good time to embrace the waves of change with grace, knowing that even after the most turbulent shifting, the shoreline always finds its way back to peaceful stillness and light.
frase_do_dia: Find the steady calm within the heart of every rising wave.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of deep inner harmony and shared emotional support.
conselho: Consider grounding yourself in quiet reflection before starting your busy afternoon tasks.
